help.body.en:
NEARBYIM TERMINAL

CHAT & DEVICES
chats                    Conversation list
scan / nearby            Scan LAN for 8 seconds
connect HOST:PORT        Connect to an address
peer ID                  Select a known device
disconnect               Pause files and close this session
older / latest           Page through local history
search TEXT              Find text in the selected chat

FILES
file PATH                Choose a file; confirm before sending
files PATH               One path per line; Ctrl+J adds a line
transfers                Show transfer records
pause ID / resume ID     Pause or continue a file
cancel ID                Cancel a transfer
reveal ID                Open its saved location
export ID PATH           Export without overwrite

IDENTITY & SAFETY
security                 Remembered devices and verification
code                     Show the complete safety code
verify FULL_CODE         Record comparison of the full code
unverify                 Remove manual verification
qr [OUTPUT.png]          Show/save the complete identity QR
verify-qr IMAGE          Compare a QR and record verification
avatar set PATH          Choose an avatar image
avatar reset / show      Reset or inspect the avatar
avatar export PATH       Export an avatar PNG

SETTINGS & OTHER
settings                 Show settings
set KEY VALUE            Save a setting
set language system|en|zh-CN|zh-Hant|ja|ko    Switch language now
listen on|off            Explicit LAN reception
status                   Read the full last status/error
help                     Open this page
quit / q                 Pause active files before exit

KEYBOARD
{commands}               Command palette
Tab / Shift+Tab          Change focus
j/k or Up/Down           Choose a peer outside the composer
Enter                    Connect or send
Alt+Enter / Ctrl+J       Insert newline
Ctrl+F / /               Search (outside composer for /)
a                        Attach (outside composer)
Ctrl+U                   Clear the editor
Ctrl+L                   Return to chat composer
PageUp / PageDown        Scroll
Esc                      Cancel/back; never grants consent
Ctrl+C                   Exit and restore the terminal
1 / 2 / 3                Chats / scan / files outside composer

SAFETY NOTES
Listening is off by default. Discovery hints do not prove identity or online status.
Only one active session: disconnect before switching peers.
Incoming files require approval unless remembered-device auto-receive is enabled.
Encrypted transport, first-use consent and manual identity verification are separate.
A saved receipt is not a read receipt. Local history is not encrypted at rest.
NIM4 and terminal command names are unchanged.
